The question asks what we know will happen in the next twenty years if gold has gone up in value over the last twenty years. 

Just because gold has increased in value over the past twenty years does not guarantee it will continue to do so in the future. Prices of commodities like gold can fluctuate due to many factors such as economic conditions, market demand, geopolitical events, and more. Therefore, we cannot be certain that gold will keep going up, stay the same, or go down. 

The only accurate statement is that gold could either rise or fall in value in the next twenty years. We do not have certainty about future price movements based solely on past performance.

Answer: D
